# `aitbc operations governance delegate`

Delegate voting power from one address to another.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations governance delegate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--delegator` | text | — | yes | Delegator address |
| `--delegate` | text | — | yes | Delegate address |
| `--amount` | integer | — | yes | Amount of voting power to delegate |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations governance delegate --delegator <delegator> --delegate <delegate> --amount <amount>
```
